setup: The third side of the triangle is \([[third_side]]\) units long, and the midsegment joins the midpoints of the other two sides.

steps.say: The triangle above the midsegment is similar to the whole triangle with a ratio of one half, because both of its sides are half the corresponding sides and the included angle is shared.

Similarity then gives the midsegment as half of \([[third_side]]\), which is \([[midsegment]]\). The midsegment is also parallel to the third side, and that parallelism is the other half of the theorem.

answer: So the midsegment is \([[midsegment]]\) units long.
